    ABOUT US


    One of our corporate ideals is making our client the focus of our business. This is achieved, among others through our culture of continuous improvement by integrated team work and effective supply chain management. We pride ourselves in the application of the best professional practice and innovation. In doing this, we are positively rewriting the industry rules and creating a new competitive niche. Our continuous search and acquisition of knowledge and better resources enhances our flexibility and response to an ever-changing environment like ours. Involving our employees is a way of life in our organisation as we treat each other with trust and respect which make us an efficient team. In addition, our company conduct is pursued in a manner that is socially responsible and commands respect for its integrity. We are therefore, conscious of the importance of listening to our clients, community and user groups, so that we respond effectively at all times to all stakeholders involved in our project delivery.

    Founders Message

    ARC UMARU U.K.

    CEO/PRESIDENT

    HISTORY

    D&B Limited is Nigeria's first architecture and construction firm engaged in designing, building, and facility management.

    ​

    We are an indigenous firm owned and managed by a team of qualified, creative and experienced professional whose depth of industry experience goes back years before the establishment of this company in 1995. And in order to improve the built environment in Nigeria, we have been sourcing experts from around the world (China, Italy, Israel, UK, UAE, Yugoslavia, Romania, Ghana etc) to work under our indigenous team leaders in order to guarantee an international standard.

    ​

    Our headquarters is located in the heart of the nation's capital, Abuja, while our projects are nationwide.

    GOAL

    To elevate the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry in Nigeria by producing timeless architectural design and construction.

    VISION

    To be the pioneers of avant-garde architecture and the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry in Nigeria.

    MISSION

    To harness the power of innovative design tools and construction methodologies to consistently deliver high quality, cost effective timeless architecture, on time.

    OUR SERVICES

    BUILDING
    DESIGN

    D&B Limited has a sophisticated level of knowledge and experience of a broad range of buildings projects. Our project experience equips us with the necessary skills to bring buildings and structures to life with form and function. We integrate our multidisciplinary services and work in collaboration with our clients to problem solve and explore different solutions to deliver extraordinary results.

    BUILDING CONSTRUCTION

    D & B Limited provides construction services that integrate schedule and cost control into day-to-day activities to keep projects on schedule and on budget. These include project management, project controls, subcontractor outreach, commissioning and start up, closeout, risk management services, self-performance, design management and many more.

    BUILDING PROJECTS
    MANAGEMENT

    D & B Limited takes the strain out of running your support services and free up your time and money to concentrate on what really matters to your organization. Using our expertise and market knowledge, we deliver an efficient, professional service that is individually tailored to your needs and reflects your corporate objectives and ethics.

    BUILDING ELEMENTS
    PRODUCTION

    Today's construction industry requires innovative materials that are strong, flexible and cost- effective. D & B Ltd precast elements, such as hollow core slabs and readymade sandwich walls, speed up construction time and ensure top quality results. Pipe floors, integrated hollow core slabs and walls allow space for pipes and conduits for increased building flexibility and adaptability.
